sources.summary: London-based designer Billy Easter has released a cubic table lamp made from silicone that can change colour by manually slotting different translucent slabs into it. The Gel Lamp, released last month through Easter's studio Public Parts, comprises a hollow cube of silicone –measuring approximately 11.5-by-11.5-by-11.5 centimetres – the base of which contains a dimmable LED. The post Billy Easter's Gel Lamp shifts colour using transposable slides appeared first on Dezeen .
